payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks, as it consistently achieves the highest performance metrics and requires comprehensive understanding of documents.

claims.text: The Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective pre-training task, outperforming Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
SR consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores on both CNNDM and NYT datasets after adding more data to pre-training.
Using all three tasks together generally outperforms using them individually, but SR still shows superior performance overall.
